summary: @tqm-mfe/main@5.5.0 requires human review — automated tracing withheld
details: Automated behavioral tracing engaged with the package contents but its output was withheld by a content safety filter, and no a static rule produced concrete findings. No specific installer-harm mechanism (exfiltration endpoint, credential read path, install-time fetch-and-execute, backdoor, or dropper) has been observed or cited in the available evidence for this version. Without a concrete traced fingerprint (hardcoded C2, credential path read, lifecycle-script remote fetch, browser/wallet enumeration, or shell-history/session theft), a public block cannot be justified on this record alone. The content-filter incompleteness is a signal to scrutinize the package further via human review rather than to auto-classify.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
